tea.name: Menghai Shou
tea.originalName: 勐海熟普洱 (Měng Hǎi Shú Pǔ'ěr)

timing.description: Effects build gradually and can last several hours with multiple infusions

recommendations: Use gongfu brewing (multiple short infusions) for sustained, evolving experience
Can be enjoyed throughout the day
Start with 2-3 infusions, pause to assess effects before continuing
warnings: Individual sensitivity varies - reduce amount or steep time if effects are too strong

trace.reason: Extract compound and terroir data
L-theanine creates mental calm and euphoric sensation
Caffeine provides stimulation that synergizes with L-theanine
Catechins/EGCG create body sensations and 'buzz' (estimated from tea type and processing)
High elevation → slower growth → more amino acids (L-theanine + catechins)
Empirical cultural knowledge - certain tea types have stronger tea drunk effects
Determine intensity level from total score
